correctness.rationale: Original stable μ survives, so pruned hospital-DA ν is perfect and hospitalwise weakly preferred to μ. When n≤2 any distinct perfect ν exchanges both partners and both hospitals strictly improve, so removed original μ pairs cannot block. The displayed three-pair preferences have unique μ=(2,1,3); radius-one around hospital ranks (2,2,3) removes precisely (H3,R1); DA yields ν=(1,2,3), blocked by that removed pair. The safe-direction theorem follows since hospital-optimal full σ dominates μ, survives all below-μ deletions, and any omitted edge cannot block pruned ν, forcing ν=σ. Independent exhaustive 288 small retaining-reference prunings and direct witness confirm boundaries; not an all-n proof.

final_claim: In balanced strict complete one-to-one matching, reciprocal deletion retaining a full stable perfect matching cannot make hospital-proposing DA originally unstable for n≤2. For n=3, exact hospital rank predictions and common radius-one windows can delete exactly one pair, preserve a unique original stable matching, and yield an originally blocked pruned DA output. For all n, removing only hospital-inferior-to-μ pairs is safe and recovers the full hospital-optimal matching.
